description: This file is the main implementation for a gRPC server managing the VHAL (Vehicle Hardware Abstraction Layer) in an Android automotive environment. It initializes the server with configuration parameters, sets up fake hardware and proxy server objects, and starts the server listening on specified addresses.

classes.name: FakeVehicleHardware
classes.description: A class representing a fake implementation of vehicle hardware for testing or virtualization purposes.

classes.name: GrpcVehicleProxyServer
classes.description: A class implementing the gRPC server that proxies vehicle hardware interactions.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: Entry point for initializing and starting the VHAL gRPC server, setting up hardware and server configuration based on command-line arguments.
